Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a snowfield in deep blue twilight shadow. Above it the blue hour in the high mountains: the sky runs from warm peach at the horizon through teal to deep indigo above, the first stars are out, and bright curtains of green and violet aurora borealis hang across the upper sky all the way round. A low golden sun sits just above the peaks in the left third. All the way round the horizon stands a wall of enormous jagged snow peaks, their tops glowing pink with alpenglow, their feet in blue haze, reaching up to a quarter of the image height. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
